p='evals/ask/heldout/recurrence_gold.py'
s=open(p).read()
old_start=s.index('def _series(')
new='''# A move is three days at most (a Saturday before a Monday holiday); an occurrence whose unmoved day lies more
# than this before the asked range cannot reach it, so it is skipped unmoved (the table covers 2026 and 2027 only).
REACH = datetime.timedelta(days=10)


def _unmoved_series(todo: dict, until: datetime.date):
    """Every occurrence as the rule gives it, before any move, up to ``until``."""
    k = 0
    while True:
        day = _unmoved(todo, k)
        if day > until:
            return
        yield day
        k += 1


def occurrences(todo: dict, start: datetime.date, end: datetime.date) -> list[datetime.date]:
    """Every occurrence from start to end (both included), each moved the same way."""
    found = []
    for day in _unmoved_series(todo, end):
        if day < start - REACH:
            continue
        moved = _moved(todo, day)
        if start <= moved <= end:
            found.append(moved)
    return found


def next_occurrence(todo: dict, today: datetime.date) -> datetime.date:
    """The first occurrence on or after today, moved as a weekend or holiday moves it."""
    k = 0
    while True:
        day = _unmoved(todo, k)
        if day >= today - REACH:
            moved = _moved(todo, day)
            if moved >= today:
                return moved
        k += 1


def year_total'''
end=s.index('def year_total')
s=s[:old_start]+new+s[end+len('def year_total'):]
open(p,'w').write(s)
